fusions.name: Travelling Spark
fusions.desc: Lights a strand that reaches the first enemy in its path, dealing 4 fire damage. The spark then runs along your hair to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each taking 60% of that.

fusions.name: Singeing Corona
fusions.desc: Every strand catches at once and flares out in a ring, dealing 28 fire damage that ignores resistance to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and setting them [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Lit Curtain
fusions.desc: Hangs a curtain of burning hair 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Burnt-Down Fuse
fusions.desc: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, the spark at the end of that strand jumps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 8 damage and setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
